tei:div.tei:p: /khyung tshang pa rin chen bzang po la gdams pa bzhugs so//

/dge slong rin chen bzang po'i yi ge sman mchog ja phyi nang*/ dar kha do rab dkar legs pa rnams 'phrod pa dang*/ deng sang khams gzugs snyoms/ mtshams sogs sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung ste/ rang gzhan gyi don la brtson par gnas zhes thos pas spro ba ches cher rgyas par gyur/ 'dir yang kho bo cag 'dus pa dang bcas pa khams snyoms/ rje btsun gong ma'i bka' srol mi nyams zhing*/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang ratna tsarya'i mchod rten chen po 'grub tu nye ba tsam du yod/ yi ge rten bcas bskur ba rjes su yi rang*/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas btab yod/ dge sbyor ngo sprod sogs dgos zhes pa'i don du/ sa lam bgrod pa'i 'gros dang*/ ngo sprod gang zag gcig sangs rgya ba'i lam rim tshang bar byas pa'i gdams pa shog dril dang*/ yi ge'i rten du thud gdar gcig la rgyas btab pa bskur yod pas rtsis len gal che/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes la dpal 'bri gung byang chub gling nas bris// oṃ swa sti/ slar yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod sngon chad bsod nams che bsags pas// da lta mi lus rin chen thob// thub pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// tshigs gsum bsnyen par rdzogs par byas// de sdom gsum dril ba'i 'byung sa yin// slar ma nyams phyis kyang mi nyams shing*// stobs bcu'i 'bras bu thob par bgyis// gnyis pa lhag bsam ma bskyed na// stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims kyang*// theg pa dman par gol bas na// byang chub thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur// des na byang sems lhag bsam dag /nus ldan dag las blang bar bya// bdag smin gzhan phan brtson par bya// sa lam bar chad dag las grol// dbugs 'byin thob cing phyir mi ldog /da dung tshe gcig sangs rgyas ni// thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa brtan// chu 'bog gcig la rje bcang gnyis// lus rten 'di la dka' na yang*// kha cig gsang sngags dus min zhes// smra ba thos chung bsod nams dman// lam log rjes 'brangs rab spangs te// rdo rje theg par gnas par bya// lus ngag yid gsum rdo rjer bsgyur// bsgyur byed rdo rje slob dpon la// rdo rje 'chang chen sangs rgyas su// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed par bya// bskyed la smin byed dbang nos nas// grol byed zab lam bskyed rdzogs bsgom// rang lus gdod nas lha sku la// rten 'brel brda thabs ngo sprod bya// gnas lugs shes pa gtan la phob// 'di yongs grub yin pas btsal mi dgos// kun btags gzhan dbang 'khrul pa'i blo// gshis la mi gnas 'grub mi 'gyur// don spyi sgom par gyur pas na// don dngos thob par mi 'gyur te// brtan pa thob la ring du 'gyur// de bas gnyis 'dzin spangs nas ni// gnyis med ye shes brtan par gyis// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni// rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag las bshad// de yang rten 'brel brda thabs dag

/med na mi 'byung nges pas na// bla ma'i dus mtha' bstan par bya// rang sems rtogs na sangs rgyas shing*// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen 'grub// 'di 'ang gzhan nas btsal du med// nor bu sngags sman sbyor ba ltar// sems la blta dang ma bral na// zhi gnas ting 'dzin bzhi thob nas// tshogs sbyor mthong sgom slob pa'i lam// mi slob phyir mi ldog thob 'gyur/ kha cig sa lam ma bsgoms shing*// lta ba yas phub rgyu 'bras dor// cig car thod rgal yod ces smra// de yang mthon po'i 'dzin stangs yin// lta ba yod de rtogs pa med// rang re'i rjes 'brang bu slob rnams// rtogs pa thob par 'dod pas na// rim gyis dag la slob par bya// rtogs pa goms pa sgom pa yin// sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med pa de// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag yin// chos rje nyid kyi gsungs pas na// dran pa rgyun chad med par bsten// dran pa zhes bya 'ang tha snyad yin// kyai'i rdo rje las// gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgoms par// 'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya// gsungs pa'i don de gang zhe na// lta ba khas len bral ba yin// sgom pa yid byed bral ba yin// spyod pa blang dor bral ba yin// 'bras bu lhan skyes rnam gsum yin// de go bar gyis la nyams su longs// dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgya yis thob// chos lnga ldan gyi don tshang ngo sprod gnyis// khyod dad ldan gyi slob ma snying stobs can// ban ldom rin chen bzang po la// snying nas gces par gdams pa yin// dge bas byang chub thob par shog /maṅgalaṃ//
